author: Ray Dalio
text: There is nothing more important than understanding how reality works and how to deal with it.
chapter: Part II, Chapter 1 — Embrace Reality and Deal with It

author: Ray Dalio
text: I have found it helpful to think of my life as if it were a game in which each problem I face is a puzzle I need to solve. By solving the puzzle, I get a gem in the form of a principle that helps me avoid the same sort of problem in the future.
chapter: Part II, Chapter 1 — Embrace Reality and Deal with It

author: Ray Dalio
text: Dreams + Reality + Determination = A Successful Life.
chapter: Part II, Chapter 1 — Embrace Reality and Deal with It — 1.1 Be a hyperrealist.

author: Ray Dalio
text: Truth—or, more precisely, an accurate understanding of reality—is the essential foundation for any good outcome.
chapter: Part II, Chapter 1 — Embrace Reality and Deal with It — 1.2 Truth

author: Ray Dalio
text: Radical open-mindedness and radical transparency are invaluable for rapid learning and effective change.
chapter: Part II, Chapter 1 — Embrace Reality and Deal with It — 1.3 Be radically open-minded and radically transparent.

author: Ray Dalio
text: Don’t let fears of what others think of you stand in your way.
chapter: Part II, Chapter 1 — Embrace Reality and Deal with It — 1.3 Be radically open-minded and radically transparent.

author: Ray Dalio
text: Embracing radical truth and radical transparency will bring more meaningful work and more meaningful relationships.
chapter: Part II, Chapter 1 — Embrace Reality and Deal with It — 1.3 Be radically open-minded and radically transparent.

author: Ray Dalio
text: Don’t get hung up on your views of how things “should” be because you will miss out on learning how they really are.
chapter: Part II, Chapter 1 — Embrace Reality and Deal with It — 1.4 Look to nature to learn how reality works.

author: Ray Dalio
text: To be “good” something must operate consistently with the laws of reality and contribute to the evolution of the whole; that is what is most rewarded.
chapter: Part II, Chapter 1 — Embrace Reality and Deal with It — 1.4 Look to nature to learn how reality works.

author: Ray Dalio
text: Evolution is the single greatest force in the universe; it is the only thing that is permanent and it drives everything.
chapter: Part II, Chapter 1 — Embrace Reality and Deal with It — 1.4 Look to nature to learn how reality works.

author: Ray Dalio
text: Evolve or die.
chapter: Part II, Chapter 1 — Embrace Reality and Deal with It — 1.4 Look to nature to learn how reality works.

author: Ray Dalio
text: Evolving is life’s greatest accomplishment and its greatest reward.
chapter: Part II, Chapter 1 — Embrace Reality and Deal with It — 1.5 Evolving is life’s greatest accomplishment and its greatest reward.

author: Ray Dalio
text: Realize that you are simultaneously everything and nothing—and decide what you want to be.
chapter: Part II, Chapter 1 — Embrace Reality and Deal with It — 1.5 Evolving is life’s greatest accomplishment and its greatest reward.

author: Ray Dalio
text: It is a fundamental law of nature that in order to gain strength one has to push one’s limits, which is painful.
chapter: Part II, Chapter 1 — Embrace Reality and Deal with It — 1.6 Understand nature’s practical lessons.

author: Ray Dalio
text: Pain + Reflection = Progress.
chapter: Part II, Chapter 1 — Embrace Reality and Deal with It — 1.7 Pain + Reflection = Progress.

author: Ray Dalio
text: Go to the pain rather than avoid it.
chapter: Part II, Chapter 1 — Embrace Reality and Deal with It — 1.7 Pain + Reflection = Progress.

author: Ray Dalio
text: Whatever circumstances life brings you, you will be more likely to succeed and find happiness if you take responsibility for making your decisions well instead of complaining about things being beyond your control.
chapter: Part II, Chapter 1 — Embrace Reality and Deal with It — 1.9 Own your outcomes.

author: Ray Dalio
text: It seems to me that the personal evolutionary process—the looping I described in the last chapter—takes place in five distinct steps. If you can do those five things well, you will almost certainly be successful.
chapter: Part II, Chapter 2 — Use the 5-Step Process to Get What You Want Out of Life

author: Ray Dalio
text: You will need to do all five steps well to be successful and you must do them one at a time and in order.
chapter: Part II, Chapter 2 — Use the 5-Step Process to Get What You Want Out of Life

author: Ray Dalio
text: While you can have virtually anything you want, you can’t have everything you want.
chapter: Part II, Chapter 2 — Use the 5-Step Process to Get What You Want Out of Life — 2.1 Have clear goals.

author: Ray Dalio
text: Don’t confuse goals with desires. A proper goal is something that you really need to achieve. Desires are things that you want that can prevent you from reaching your goals.
chapter: Part II, Chapter 2 — Use the 5-Step Process to Get What You Want Out of Life — 2.1 Have clear goals.

author: Ray Dalio
text: Never rule out a goal because you think it’s unattainable. Be audacious.
chapter: Part II, Chapter 2 — Use the 5-Step Process to Get What You Want Out of Life — 2.1 Have clear goals.

author: Ray Dalio
text: Remember that great expectations create great capabilities.
chapter: Part II, Chapter 2 — Use the 5-Step Process to Get What You Want Out of Life — 2.1 Have clear goals.

author: Ray Dalio
text: Almost nothing can stop you from succeeding if you have a) flexibility and b) self-accountability.
chapter: Part II, Chapter 2 — Use the 5-Step Process to Get What You Want Out of Life — 2.1 Have clear goals.

author: Ray Dalio
text: View painful problems as potential improvements that are screaming at you.
chapter: Part II, Chapter 2 — Use the 5-Step Process to Get What You Want Out of Life — 2.2 Identify and don’t tolerate problems.

author: Ray Dalio
text: Acknowledging your weaknesses is not the same as surrendering to them. It’s the first step toward overcoming them.
chapter: Part II, Chapter 2 — Use the 5-Step Process to Get What You Want Out of Life — 2.2 Identify and don’t tolerate problems.

author: Ray Dalio
text: Once you identify a problem, don’t tolerate it. Tolerating a problem has the same consequences as failing to identify it.
chapter: Part II, Chapter 2 — Use the 5-Step Process to Get What You Want Out of Life — 2.2 Identify and don’t tolerate problems.

author: Ray Dalio
text: Strategic thinking requires both diagnosis and design.
chapter: Part II, Chapter 2 — Use the 5-Step Process to Get What You Want Out of Life — 2.3 Diagnose problems to get at their root causes.

author: Ray Dalio
text: You can only truly solve your problems by removing their root causes, and to do that, you must distinguish the symptoms from the disease.
chapter: Part II, Chapter 2 — Use the 5-Step Process to Get What You Want Out of Life — 2.3 Diagnose problems to get at their root causes.

author: Ray Dalio
text: Remember: Designing precedes doing!
chapter: Part II, Chapter 2 — Use the 5-Step Process to Get What You Want Out of Life — 2.4 Design a plan.

author: Ray Dalio
text: Great planners who don’t execute their plans go nowhere.
chapter: Part II, Chapter 2 — Use the 5-Step Process to Get What You Want Out of Life — 2.5 Push through to completion.

author: Ray Dalio
text: Knowing what your weaknesses are and staring hard at them is the first step on the path to success.
chapter: Part II, Chapter 2 — Use the 5-Step Process to Get What You Want Out of Life — 2.6 Remember that weaknesses don’t matter if you find solutions.
